references.context: Field theory: irreducible polynomial in the univariate polynomial ring F[x]

references.phrase: roots of a polynomial in a field
references.context: Field theory: root of polynomial f, an element α with f(α)=0

references.disposition: Distinct-root cardinality is used; repeated roots of f count once, and no general equality with the polynomial degree is assumed.

review_rationale: Examined the count of distinct roots of an irreducible polynomial in an algebraic closure of the coefficient field, distinguishing separable degree from its usual polynomial degree and from extension degree.
